Urban Development.

yearly updates.

expand access to housing, but also to
improve the quality of housing, maximize
leasing and budget utilization, increase
housing choices, and promote promote
fair housing for all residents.

rental assistance to 650 households.

we utilize over 100% of HUD funding.

Housing Choice vouchers and 100
project-based vouchers that is
distributed across two properties.

contract that will be presented to you

I want to highlight that this property
was fully leased within just 48 days.

collaboration with our partners.

vouchers for non-elderly disabled adults
and 37 emergency housing vouchers for
homeless individuals and families.
